raw_definitions: Definisi : we had better ~ their plan to build yet another hotel, lebih baik kita mematahkan rancangan mereka utk membina sebuah hotel lagi. (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)

Definisi : vt (put an end to) menghentikan; (frustrate) mematahkan: he determined to ~ that rumour before it had a chance to spread, dia berazam utk menghentikan khabar angin itu sebelum dapat merebak; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
